probes.title: Edge write-path decomposition
probes.claim: A taught fact is written by multiple independent mechanisms; removing either alone lowers but does not remove the edge.

measurements.name: writers_fired
measurements.detail: 2 add_edge calls for one taught fact

measurements.name: redundancy_decomposes
measurements.detail: each single ablation lowers but does not remove the edge

probes.title: STDP substrate under real conversation
probes.claim: Real turns write synapses with the exact STDP weight — and the 50ms user→thought gap means response concepts never bind to the user's words.

measurements.name: ablated_silent
measurements.detail: STDP off → the substrate stays flat

measurements.name: user_thought_binding_present
measurements.detail: thought-only concepts=[]; user topics spike ≥40ms before thought topics — outside the STDP window, so user words don't bind to response-only concepts

probes.title: TD reward chain under real turns
probes.claim: The interaction reward trains action-conditioned values; ablating the update flattens the dopamine channel that gates plasticity.

measurements.name: ablated_dopamine_flat
measurements.detail: TD update off → no dopamine signal

measurements.name: downstream_differs
measurements.detail: TD feeds STDP gating — at minimum the dopamine channel differs

probes.title: Yes/no verification is load-bearing
probes.claim: Ablating question_verify_relation removes the verdict and degrades the rendered answer — the path carries verification.

measurements.name: ablated_verdict_gone
measurements.detail: with the path ablated no verdict is produced

verbatim.intact: Yes — sog is a kind of jeg. I don't know if that's really true.
verbatim.ablated: I don't quite follow jeg. What do you mean?

probes.title: Semantic memory carries taught facts, not episodic
probes.claim: Ablating episode storage leaves edge-based recall intact — the systems carry different kinds of memory.

measurements.name: episodes_ablated_zero
measurements.detail: store ablated → nothing lands in LTM

measurements.name: semantic_recall_survives
measurements.detail: recall with zero episodes: 'Kif is a hut. It is the hut.'

verbatim.ablated_recall: Kif is a hut. It is the hut.

probes.title: Uncertainty gate net contribution
probes.claim: Measured net change in decline rate with the hedge gate removed — whether the gate adds honesty or duplicates the composer's own restraint.

measurements.name: gate_net_effect
measurements.detail: positive = gate adds honesty; 0 = composer already declines
